Hedgehog’s Story Map

Age 4–5 YearsClass 29 · StorytimeSkill Who, where, what

Find WHO the story is about, WHERE it happens, and WHAT happened — a real story map.

Play the story game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · WHO, WHERE, WHAT

Hedgehog’s Story Map

Every story has a who, a where, and a what. Look at Hedgehog’s scene and tap the answer for each row.

WHO is this story about?

WHERE does the story happen?

WHAT happened in the story?

Story map complete!

Hedgehog, in the garden, found an apple.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains who, where, what on the story picture itself: the questions are spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to say the answer out loud before tapping — the retelling is where comprehension really grows.

Prefer paper? The Hedgehog’s Story Map worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
